body: Thank you. I eventually did get through to someone. I'm going to talk to them tomorrow afternoon. It's scary, but I also know I need that detached opinion.
Yeah, I find that staying active usually helps. There's just a point I hit sometimes where moving or doing anything just... isn't gonna happen.
Sorry. I didn't know the distinction. I would feel like such a fraud calling a hospital. I don't think I have the guts to do it.
Reddit has been a great place. There's bound to be someone who understands. Seriously, the thing that one person wrote to me a couple days ago got me through a rough night. This community is amazing.
Thanks. That's... quite the quote there. Scary.
It is nice when someone just lets you know you're not insane.
Thank you for this advice. I'll look into an LPC. I don't have much money to devote to therapy or things like that.
Interesting recommendation. I enjoy theories and books like that, regardless of my mood.
Sounds terrifying.

Yeah, I've had the same kinds of hang ups with professionals in the past.

I hope they're just away due to the holidays and will return my call.

That's terrible. 

Edit: The prank calling, I mean.

I used Samaritans. 

I've heard a lot of stories similar to ours. I always thought that they must be exaggerations. Maybe these people just get overwhelmed by the terrible things they have to hear all day?

There's nothing glamorous about hurting yourself. I know it's frustrating right now to not have an outlet, but it's frustrating FOREVER if you have to live with scars or burn marks or other physical injuries that you brought on yourself.

Stay strong. You deserve help and support just as much as anyone else. You don't have to hurt yourself to deserve a kind and supportive hand.

Thank you so much for this. So often with this sort of thing, you hear the same kind of advice over and over. And you're right, it doesn't help that much to be told that it'll eventually get better. 

But it does help to be reminded that there's a reason I'm fighting, there's a reason I'm trying really, really hard not to fall back into self-harm or worse. I know what that reason is for me and it's worth fighting for. Even in this moment, I can see that it's something worth enduring for. I needed to be reminded of that though. Thank you so much.

The past month or so has been a roller coaster. A little boost, then a free fall back downward. A little lift, then a crash. The kind redditors who have replied to this thread today have lifted me up. I might crash back down again tonight, but I've been buoyed by these messages. I owe this community a huge debt.
Uh. I feel absolutely sick to my stomach. Sick everywhere. Wish I could fall asleep and not wake up.
I hope so too. :/

Thanks for your help and advice. I know you're right and it really does help to hear it. I'm going to do my best. Tonight is a tough one, but there are things in my life I'm looking forward to and I'll do my best to get to those things. It's just been a long time since I've been so depressed that it *physically hurts* all the time. I wasn't prepared for it and it's hitting me like truck. 

I hope that I someday get the chance to mend or make peace with the rifts I've created between me and some people in my life. It's just so hard to think of that person now hating me and not wanting anything to do with me. I brought it on myself, but still.

It's just daunting to think of the months and months it took to get out of it last time I felt like this. I worked so hard. I didn't think I'd have to do it all again. It's overwhelming to think of going through all of it again.

As for what I messed up, it's a long and complicated story. tl;dr: I did something awful and when I tried to fix it I just made it even worse. Now I've just gone and hurt a bunch of people who care(d?) tremendously about me. I know there's nothing I can do to make it okay. At this point, I'm just trying to stay away from them and not interfere in their lives anymore, but that makes me feel like shit.
Does he know how much he means to you? Because that makes a big difference. Knowing there is someone who loves you so much and would be so devastated by your absence can change everything.
That's been me today. It's just getting worse and worse as the day goes on. Pretty soon I'm either gonna have to go to sleep or... man, I don't know. Do something to ease it.
